purpose: Teach: 公債/渡航/出国/通院/含有/取り扱っ/照会/婚姻

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、公債への投資を慎重に進めろ
lines.en: We need to proceed carefully with our government bond investments.
lines.style: Direct, measured opening. Calm authority. Each phrase lands with weight. No room for misinterpretation. The tone of someone accustomed to being listened to.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。海外渡航する社員の手配を進めております
lines.en: Understood. I'm currently arranging the paperwork for our staff traveling abroad.
lines.style: Attentive, methodical. Slight forward lean in posture. Each task item precise. The voice of someone taking notes even if they're not. Reassuring competence.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、出国手続きを社員にきちんと案内しろ
lines.en: Make sure our staff receive clear, proper guidance on departure procedures.
lines.style: Firm directive. Slight emphasis on 「clearly」. Not questioning, instructing. Brief pause at the end. The kind of order that expects a simple acknowledgment.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員の通院を考慮した勤務体制を整えます
lines.en: Understood. We're putting together a work schedule that accounts for staff medical appointments.
lines.style: Steady, responsive. Shows he's already thinking ahead. No hesitation. The voice of someone building trust through follow-through, not words.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、添加物の含有量を明示しろ
lines.en: Ensure all additive content in our products is clearly disclosed.
lines.style: Clipped, decisive. No softening. The voice of compliance and accountability. Slight pause between subject and demand, for weight.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お得意様情報を慎重に取り扱っております
lines.en: Understood. We're handling all client information with the appropriate level of care and discretion.
lines.style: Smooth, professional reassurance. Calm cadence. Voice rises slightly at the end — a small confirmation that the message landed. No defensiveness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: お客様からの照会には迅速に対応しろ
lines.en: Respond to customer inquiries promptly. That's non-negotiable.
lines.style: Sharp, final. No elaboration needed. The tone shifts from instruction to expectation. Brief, breath-level pause before the last phrase.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員の婚姻届け、お祝いいたします
lines.en: Understood. And congratulations to our staff member on their marriage.
lines.style: Warm close that catches slightly by surprise. Genuine smile underneath. A small pivot from command to human recognition. Softer but still contained.
